name: jpmorgan-financial-apis-mcp
description: MCP Server for JPMorgan Financial APIs - Accounts, Balances, Transfers, Transactions, LLM Analysis
long_description: Docker MCP Catalog entry for production financial APIs. Tools: get_accounts, get_balance, transfer_funds, get_transactions, analyze_financial_data. GPU/LLM Model Runner ready. (Updated: Added standard $schema for VSCode validation)
author: JPMorgan Financial Team

tools.name: analyze_financial_data
tools.description: LLM analysis of financial data (risk/insights with GPU Model Runner)

requirements: Python 3.12+, Docker, NVIDIA GPU (optional for ML/LLM)
publish: docker push yourorg/jpmorgan-financial-mcp && docker mcp catalog add mcp.json
